basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas, who recently stumbled onto Reddit while searching for a community to share my love of tech and gaming. My interests include cryptocurrency, particularly Dogecoin, and I enjoy tinkering with gadgets and gaming peripherals in my free time. After a rough breakup at the end of 2021, I've been navigating the single life while diving deeper into online communities for support and distraction. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, between 7 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Austin. My job as a software developer has honed my technical skills, and I've self-taught myself about cryptocurrencies through online courses and forums. I also have a keen interest in gaming peripherals, sparked by years of online gaming.
